Maya Ortiz: Heads-up — prepping QBR cost slide for HelioTech renewal. Need 30/60/90 token snapshot, embed pilot uplift scenarios, onboarding blockers, and contingency credit recommendation.

Kenji Watanabe: Pulling numbers now. Do we want breakdown hosted vs dedicated?

Maya Ortiz: Yes — separate lines and a blended forecast. Also call out any bulk job spikes.

Lara Gomez: FYI their nightly analytics export caused a 2x seq-length bump one week ago. I'll surface logs.

Kenji Watanabe: Drafts:
``
30d: 34.2M tokens (hosted 31.8M / ded-embed 2.4M)
60d: 67.0M
90d: 101.5M
Run-rate: ~1.13M tokens/day
Forecast baseline: 110-135M tokens
Cost delta vs prior qtr: +10-16%
```

Maya Ortiz: Can you create conservative/medium/upside scenarios with embed conversion 0/25/50% and spell assumptions?

Kenji Watanabe: Will do. Conservative=0%, medium=25%, upside=50%. I'll include procurement stress metric if variance >15%.

Lara Gomez: Onboarding blocker: OAuth token rotation broke for ~6 days, delaying mobile activations (~15% seats). ETA to fix: 8 days.

cs-bot: Reminder — use QBR template sections: "budget-risk" and "mitigations" https://redwood.company/qbr-templates

Maya Ortiz: Enablement asks: 1) 30-min embed batching session, 2) quota-guard walkthrough, 3) suggested credit band. Who can run sessions?

Kenji Watanabe: I can run batching demo Wed morning. I'll attach perf snippets showing batching=256 reduces token-cost ~12%.

Lara Gomez: I'll do quota-guard walkthrough and add onboarding timeline to the slide notes.

Maya Ortiz: Action items:
- Kenji: slides + scenarios by Tue 10am PT
- Lara: onboarding notes + logs by Tue noon
- Maya: draft exec ask and upload by Tue EOD

Kenji Watanabe: Uploaded draft numbers: https://drive.redwood/heliotech/qbr-draft — comments welcome.

Lara Gomez: Left comments re: assumption clarity on slide 2.

Maya Ortiz: Good work. Call out 3 quick mitigations in exec summary: 1) batching + throttle, 2) onboarding SSO fix timeline, 3) contingency credit. Closing thread unless anything else. :thumbsup:
